Doesn't know what 'מרווח' means, and 'no ceiling' sounds bad

No total yearly cost for someone like the reader; had to work it out alone

No information on whether the fund itself charges fees on top
Can't tell whether a ₪10,000 minimum is normal compared with other places
No 'open account' button or explanation of how to open the account
No information on withdrawal or exit fees

Would drop the fee-change notice
Would drop the small source links and dates
Would drop the '11 שורות עמלה נאספו' line
Would drop the search box
